name: Microsoft Xbox 360 family
summary: Explore Xbox 360 hardware in its three body styles and many motherboard revisions. Homebrew eligibility is decided by both the board revision and the dashboard/kernel version: JTAG on old kernels, RGH on most newer boards, and Bad Update (software-only) on any model at dashboard 2.0.17559.

specs.cpu: IBM PowerPC triple-core (Xenon Waternoose on first boards; later revisions on smaller processes)
specs.storage: Detachable hard drive, model-dependent; memory units; USB storage on later dashboards
specs.media: DVD drive (HD-DVD via external add-on); no Blu-ray
specs.display: Up to 1080p; HDMI on Zephyr and later and on S/E models

variants.storage: 20 GB to 120 GB hard drive; 4 GB memory unit on some bundles
variants.notes: Board revisions: Xenon, Elpis (refurbished Xenon), Zephyr, Falcon, Jasper, Tonasket. JTAG only on 2.0.7371 or lower with an unpatched CB. RGH works on all phats. Postfix Adapter not needed on phats.

specs.gpu: ATI Y1 (90 nm) with 10 MB eDRAM
specs.hdmi: Zephyr and later; not Xenon or Elpis

variants.storage: 4 GB to 250 GB depending on SKU
variants.notes: Board revisions: Trinity, Corona, Waitsburg. RGH is the only permanent mod. Peer Pressure works on Trinity only. Waitsburg needs a Postfix Adapter for RGH.

variants.storage: 250 GB or 4 GB/500 GB depending on SKU
variants.notes: Board revisions: Stingray, Barracuda (Winchester). Stingray: RGH with Postfix Adapter. Winchester boards are not compatible with RGH at all — CPU changes block entry points.

firmware.version: 2.0.17559 (latest; Microsoft no longer ships new 360 dashboards)

homebrew.name: Bad Update
homebrew.summary: A hypervisor exploit for every 360 model running dashboard 2.0.17559. It enters through a supported game or an exploited Avatar and is paired with FreeMyXe or XeUnshackle to run XEX content. Non-persistent — power-off returns the console to stock.

compatibility.note: ConsoleMods states the exploit works on all 360 models at dashboard 2.0.17559. Does not work on Xbox One or Series.

requirements: A supported game (e.g. Rock Band Blitz trial) or an exploited Avatar.
warnings: Non-persistent — code execution is lost at power-off.
Only works at dashboard 2.0.17559; a different dashboard does not have the exploit.

homebrew.name: RGH family (Reset Glitch Hack)
homebrew.firmware: All versions except 2.0.17559-only software entry; RGH1 ≤2.0.14699; RGH1.2/RGH2/RGH3/EXT_CLK above
homebrew.summary: A permanent boot-time glitch mod. The method depends on the board and dashboard: RGH1 for 2.0.14699 and lower; RGH1.2/RGH2/RGH3/EXT_CLK above. S-RGH, EXT_CLK and Project Mufas are variants for Xenon, Zephyr and special cases. Requires a glitch chip, NAND programmer and soldering.

compatibility.note: All phat revisions (Xenon, Elpis, Zephyr, Falcon, Jasper, Tonasket) can take RGH. Xenon/Zephyr support RGH3/EXT_CLK. A NAND dump and CPU key are prerequisites.
Trinity and Corona slims can take RGH. Waitsburg requires a Postfix Adapter. No RGH on 360 E.

requirements: A NAND dump and CPU key before any work.
Glitch chip, NAND programmer and soldering equipment.
For Waitsburg and Stingray boards: a Postfix Adapter.
warnings: A bad install can leave the console unbootable until the chip is removed and the NAND restored.
Soldering a glitch chip is not reversible by software.

homebrew.name: JTAG (SMC hack)
homebrew.firmware: 2.0.7371 or lower, with an unpatched CB
homebrew.summary: A permanent boot-time exploit on phat consoles running old kernels with an unpatched coprocessor. Not available on slims.

compatibility.note: Some Jasper consoles with 2.0.7371 are already patched; refurbished Xenons with Elpis GPUs also have a patched CB. Dump the NAND and check the CB before assuming a console is JTAG-able.

requirements: Dashboard 2.0.7371 or lower with an unpatched coprocessor.
A NAND dump to verify the CB state.
warnings: A dashboard version alone does not prove JTAG — the CB must be unpatched.

homebrew.name: Peer Pressure
homebrew.summary: A software exploit for phat consoles and Trinity slims at dashboard 2.0.17559. Does not work on Corona, Waitsburg or 360 E boards.

compatibility.note: Only Trinity boards support Peer Pressure. Corona and Waitsburg do not.

requirements: Dashboard 2.0.17559 on a phat or a Trinity slim.
warnings: Winchester (Barracuda) boards do not support RGH or Peer Pressure.

homebrew.name: Linux (free60 distributions)
homebrew.firmware: Requires a modded console with XeLL; no firmware-specific limit
homebrew.summary: An archive of 2007–2012-era Linux distributions (Debian, Ubuntu, Arch POWER) and the LibXenon toolchain from free60. Booting any of it needs a hacked console. These images are not maintained current distributions.

compatibility.note: Historical archive; booting requires XeLL and a modded console.

requirements: A modded Xbox 360 with XeLL installed.
warnings: Not a supported way to run Linux today. Kernels and distro images are historical.

homebrew.name: Xbox 360 system software update and reinstall
homebrew.summary: Official update and recovery for Xbox 360. The final dashboard is 2.0.17559; reinstalling does not accept older firmware.

compatibility.note: Official update track shared by the whole family.

requirements: USB drive with the official update file.

officialSupport.summary: Microsoft no longer ships new dashboards; the 2024-07-29 Store closure ended purchases, not system updates.
